title: Distinguish preexisting test-run attribution ineligibility from an execution-owner race
outcome: Prospective attribution uses a truthful reason when a disabled session, resetting project or unsupported session shape was already ineligible before capture; executionOwnerChanged is reserved for an actual currentness race. Exact reasons are covered by deterministic existing-owner tests.
acceptance: Distinguish preexisting test-run attribution ineligibility from an execution-owner race is done
